{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

display(trial_df.head())

display(trial_df.info())

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values:")
print(trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print(f"\nDuplicate rows: {trial_df.duplicated().sum()}")

# Check the distribution of the treatment and response variables
print(f"\nTreatment distribution:\n{trial_df['treatment'].value_counts()}")
print(f"\nResponse distribution:\n{trial_df['response'].value_counts()}")

# Check if the groups are comparable
print(f"\nGroup sizes:\n{trial_df.groupby('treatment')['response'].count()}")

# Look at the response rate by treatment group
response_rates = trial_df.groupby('treatment')['response'].mean()
print(f"\nResponse rates:\n{response_rates}")

# Compute the difference in proportions
control_rate = response_rates['control']
treatment_rate = response_rates['treatment']
treatment_effect = treatment_rate - control_rate

print(f"\nTreatment effect (difference in proportions): {treatment_effect}")

# Final check: ensure the data is clean and ready
assert not trial_df.isnull().any().any(), "There are missing values in the data."
assert trial_df.duplicated().sum() == 0, "There are duplicate rows in the data."
